description: This Java class models the <field> element within a widget form framework. It defines the structure and behaviors of form fields, including various types such as date pickers, checkboxes, containers, and auto-complete fields. It includes support for rendering, validation conditions, dynamic property expansion, and interaction logic. The class is designed to be immutable and to serve as a read-only data structure representing an XML-specified form field.
